ent3b.narr.page.title: Period narrative
ent3b.narr.page.subtitle: The eight narrative fields of one project in a period: status, milestones, disbursement, causes, difficulties, solutions, plan for the next period and proposals.
ent3b.narr.noReport.note: Open this screen from a draft report to enter the structured narrative of the project and period of that report.
ent3b.narr.card.title: Narrative {project} · {period}
ent3b.narr.form.label: Structured narrative
ent3b.narr.readOnly.note: The report is no longer a draft or you may only view it: the narrative cannot be edited.
ent3b.narr.problem.nothing: There is no narrative of the previous period to inherit, or every field already has words.
ent3b.narr.problem.locked: The period is locked or the report was handed in: the narrative cannot be edited.
ent3b.narr.problem.conflict: The report was just changed by someone else: reload and continue.
ent3b.narr.problem.denied: You may not edit the narrative of this project.
ent3b.narr.problem.invalid: The narrative does not meet the entry rules or has invalid content: see the lines above.
ent3b.narr.problem.general: The narrative could not be saved. Try again later.
ent3b.narr.inherited.note: This narrative began as a copy of the previous period: {fields} fields were copied, {unchanged} still carry the old words.
ent3b.narr.previous.none: The project has no handed-in structured narrative of the previous period to inherit.
ent3b.narr.previous.note: The previous period {period} has {count} fields filled in. Inheriting fills only the empty fields and never overwrites words already entered.
ent3b.narr.causes.title: Causes from the standard list
ent3b.narr.causes.none: No standard cause is in use yet: write the causes in words.
ent3b.narr.directives.title: Results of the leadership meeting directives in the period
ent3b.narr.directives.none: The project has no leadership directive in the period.
ent3b.narr.directives.truncated: The list of directives is cut short; narrow it by project to see all.
ent3b.narr.save.done: The narrative was saved to the draft.
